Name: EV1 Front SLA (DoubleWishbone on the ev1 suspension baseline hardpoints)
//PROVENANCE: Read this before treating any number in this file as an EV1 measurement.
LAYOUT - printed. EV1 chassis manual, printed page 251: 'The short/long arm
(SLA) independent front suspension used on the EV1 ... Each wheel is
independently connected to the cradle/front suspension crossmember by a
steering knuckle, wheel hub assembly, coil over shock assembly, upper and
lower ball joint and upper and lower control arm ... steered by two front tie
rods.' Chrono's DoubleWishbone is that layout.
HARDPOINTS - from the ev1 repo's suspension baseline, programmerq/ev1 commit
a6ab7146d91dcdf4536ec2abfc72f979deb1c7d6 (PR #144),
geometry/suspension/ev1_suspension_hardpoints.csv. The table under
'//hardpoints_ev1_mm' copies each front point with its tier and source, in the
body repair manual's datum frame (X rearward, Y to the car's right, Z up).
Only the damper top is a printed coordinate (body repair manual p.155). Every
arm, ball-joint, tie-rod and yoke point is the baseline's ESTIMATE, sized to
the printed envelope and the p.251 figure. None of them is measured. The
lower arm pivots sit on the cradle, whose own body mounts are under question
in the ev1 repo, so treat them as the least certain points here.
FRAME MAP - inferred, not fitted, and kept in '//frame' only. Chrono wants X
forward, Y left, Z up, origin at the vehicle file's 'Suspension Location'.
The map anchors the baseline's front wheel centre (1686, 735, 420.9) on the
spindle position the sedan-template file used, (0, 0.735, -0.08), so the
car's ride height in the chassis frame does not move:
'//coordinates' says which table point each Chrono coordinate is.
COIL-OVER YOKE. The coil-over runs from the damper top down to a fork-shaped
yoke bolted to the lower arm (chassis p.228). The yoke is rigid on the arm,
so the Spring and Shock 'Location Arm' is the yoke-to-arm bolt and the
coil-over line runs damper top to that bolt; no extra body is needed.
Not modeled: the stabilizer bar.
ALIGNMENT - printed. Camber -0.10 deg, toe -0.05 deg per wheel: chassis manual
p.61 front nominals. Track 1470 mm: chassis p.62.
SPRING, DAMPER, MASSES - see the '//' notes beside each. Nothing in them is
printed: the spring rate is the baseline's estimate, the free length and
damping are derived from it, and masses are the earlier template's.
tests/test_suspension_geometry.cpp recomputes every Chrono coordinate below
from the '//hardpoints_ev1_mm' table through the frame map, so the table and
the coordinates cannot drift apart.

//frame.//: fr_wheel_centre in the baseline is inferred: X = mean of the damper-top and rear-spring-seat anchors, Y = half printed front track, Z = derived ground + tyre loaded radius

upper_ball_joint.source: baseline: 500 mm above the lower ball joint (tall knuckle, figure PSMGCH66740AA); X and Y from printed caster 2.5 deg and an estimated 11 deg KPI

lower_ball_joint.source: baseline: inside the 14 in rim, 140 mm below the wheel centre, 10 mm ahead for trail

uca_pivot_fwd.source: baseline: upper arm bolts to the body (chassis p.246); legs straddle the coil-over

uca_pivot_rr.source: baseline: as uca_pivot_fwd, slight rise rearward for anti-dive

lca_pivot_rr.source: baseline: on the cradle (caster cam), 50 mm ahead of the printed rear cradle mount X=1999

tie_rod_inner.source: baseline: computed for zero bump steer from the estimated arms

tie_rod_outer.source: baseline: rearward steering arm (rack behind the axle on the cradle)

damper_top.source: body repair manual p.155, redux datum-b155-06; tower-to-tower span 875 mm body p.160 dim-b160-05

yoke_to_lca_bolt.source: baseline: yoke bolts to the top of the lower arm about 83% of the way out, under the damper top (chassis p.228)

Spindle.//: Mass, inertia and size carried over from the sedan-template file; not EV1 values.

Upright.//: COM at the centroid of the two ball joints and the spindle. Mass and inertia from the sedan-template file.

Upper Control Arm.//: COM at the centroid of the arm's three points. Mass and inertia from the sedan-template file.

Lower Control Arm.//: COM at the centroid of the arm's three points. Mass and inertia from the sedan-template file.

Spring.//rate: 37826 N/m: the baseline's spring_rate_front estimate (1.35 Hz ride target on its corner mass, through its 0.786 motion ratio). Not printed.
Spring.//free_length: Derived: installed length (damper top to yoke bolt) plus the static spring force over the rate. Static force = the chassis body's share of the front axle load per side (EV1_Chassis.json mass and COM, EV1_Vehicle.json axle positions) over this geometry's motion ratio at the tyre; the test recomputes it.

Shock.//: Derived for a 0.30 ride damping ratio at the wheel: 2 x 0.30 x sqrt(wheel rate x sprung corner mass), over the motion ratio squared. Not printed.
